g.text: Prompts and models can't silently get worse: CI replays the gold set on every change.
bun evals --check fails CI when accuracy drops more
than 2 points, or the set or prompt version changed
Provisional: 134 grade and 20 of 60 proof labels are
drafted and re-checked, not yet reviewed by a person.
Verifier effect: it changed 1 of 134 statuses (away from gold). Evidence: 96% of cited fields carry the answer.
